items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law, in relation
to the composition of the local advisory board for the Belmont racetrack
facility
items.lawSection: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S5481

SPONSOR: KAPLAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and
breeding law, in relation to the composition of the local advisory board
for the Belmont racetrack facility

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To constitute a fifteen member advisory board for Belmont.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1 creates a 15 member Belmont racetrack advisory board. Of these
members 6 are designees of Nassau County of which two must be residents
of Elmont, three designees by the franchised corporation, two designees
of the village of Floral Park, two from the Speaker of the Assembly, and
two from the Temporary President of the Senate.

Section 2 is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation creates a fifteen member advisory panel for the Belmont
Racetrack. Under current law both the Saratoga and Aqueduct racetracks
have fifteen member advisory panels this legislation seeks to create
parity between these three racetracks.  Further, this legislation seeks
to provide representation to Elmont, Floral Park, Nassau County and
NYRA. The goal of this advisory board is to work as a liaison between
NYRA and the local communities in Nassau County of Floral Park and
Elmont to ensure the public's voice is heard as it relates to operation
of the Belmont racetrack.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

Similar to A.8627 of 2018.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the state.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.
